body.description: What the organization does for itself: the catalog, production, stock, projects, the books and its people. Copy it for your organization to rename steps and link your own procedures.

steps.title: Define products
steps.description: Products are described once, with their variants, units and identifiers, for every app that sells, buys, makes or stores them.

steps.title: Set prices
steps.description: Price lists are drafted, reviewed and published by effective date.

steps.title: Plan production
steps.description: Demand and stock decide what to make and when; the schedule loads the work centers.

steps.title: Make
steps.description: Work orders are released, run on the floor and completed into stock.

steps.title: Catch up late work
steps.description: Work orders past their estimated completion need a new date or more capacity.

steps.title: Keep stock
steps.description: Stock on hand by product, lot and location. On hand is a snapshot and is never added across dates.

steps.title: Move stock
steps.description: Transfers move stock between facilities and locations.

steps.title: Count stock
steps.description: Counts compare the floor with the records; variances are reviewed before they adjust stock.

steps.title: Run projects
steps.description: Projects are planned, staffed and followed by their health and milestones.

steps.title: Do the work
steps.description: Work items move through their workflow; requests come in through intake.

steps.title: Record and approve time
steps.description: Time is recorded against work and approved before it is billed or costed.

steps.title: Keep the books
steps.description: What the apps do posts to the ledger; entries drafted by hand wait to be posted.

steps.title: Close the period
steps.description: Each period is reconciled, locked and closed.

steps.title: Report
steps.description: The statements are read from posted entries only.

steps.title: Hire and schedule people
steps.description: Employees, their time off and their pay. The People app is not part of this installation yet, so this step is information only.

steps.title: Keep equipment running
steps.description: Preventive and corrective work on equipment and facilities: work orders planned, assigned, done and closed, and the backlog waiting for a technician.
